disposition.target: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (GUARANTEE rule set)

disposition.note: Story keeps the share and balance composed per call under ASM-4537 and the element carries them (AC10). Publishing the row or LDM field is the owners' change.
Claim kept inside LOV-CLAIM-STATUS with the closing basis in the element (AC16). Confirmation with P3 that GUARANTEE_CLOSED is the case status stays with its owner.
Trigger is the case signal the parent forwards after the payment match (section 4 step 1, section 7 target reading). No event or timer is added here.
